# AI Customer Support Assistant & Smart Ticket Router ⚡

## 📋 Commercial Job Reference
- **Platform Source:** Malt Commercial Job Listing (Freelance Mission)
- **Client Need:** SaaS company seeking automated tier-1 customer support triage and response suggestions.
- **Estimated Market Price:** 3,000 €
- **Average TJM (Daily Rate):** 600 € / day (5 days duration)

## 🚀 Key Features
- Instant ticket triage and sentiment analysis.
- Smart auto-routing based on issue category.
- High-speed AI response drafting with O(1) response lookup cache.

## ⚡ Bolt Performance Optimizations
- **O(1) Map Caching:** Instant response retrieval for recurring ticket queries without re-processing.
- **Debounced Search:** Query processing debounced by 150ms to minimize DOM thrashing during real-time filtering.
- **Lightweight Vanilla Architecture:** Zero external framework runtime overhead for sub-10ms initial render times.
